s1.desc: a red convertible car in front of snowy teal hills

s2.desc: a snowy cliff-top parking area with a warning sign on a pole

spans.view: with a curved windscreen in front of her and a brown leather seat beside her

beats.text: Polly sits at the steering wheel of the red car, glancing to the side and blinking
Polly grips the wheel and stares straight ahead with a blank face
Polly shuts her eyes and blushes with a small satisfied smile
Polly grins with rosy cheeks, blinking and glancing around, both flippers on the wheel

Pax throws both flippers up with an open-beaked smile while sparkles twinkle above his head

beats.text: Polly bounces beside the car, eyes closed, flinging her flippers up proudly while Pax watches with his flippers clasped

Pax raises a flipper and waves it while Polly stands smiling beside the car
